text_block_list.text:
Christmas morning.
I was awoken by a soft knocking sound.
(Knock knock knock)
I rushed to open the door, and—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"...You're a sleepyhead, aren't you?
Merry Christmas."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
You see, today,
I was handing out presents to all the good children.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: That's a good question.
Inside the bag she opened after saying that—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Mar-chan Dolls and Mar-chan Mugs.
Mar-chan Clear Files and
Mar-chan Keychains."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: That's right, in short, it's official URA Chan-merch.

Was it the result of her success in races, or perhaps
the influence of her 4-panel comic being published as a book?

Official Aston Machan merchandise
was increasing at an astonishing rate.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps she's already an Ultra Super Mascot
...tentative title?"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Even so, indeed. Refusing to settle here is Aston Machan's style. How lovely.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Girls who aren't interested, or just a little bit.
I want those girls to pick up some merchandise first."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And I want them to be interested in Chan-Me.
That is why I was in the middle of handing out presents.
choice_data_list: I see, and so... for me too?
I see, and so... for me too?

text_block_list.text:
It's not just about "taking an interest"...
I *am* her Trainer, after all.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Regarding that, though.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Trainer-san is an exception.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The best kid of all good kids.
An ultra-super good kid.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"You already know all of Mar-chan's charms,
and you share those charms with everyone."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
To such a good child,
I must give something very special.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: In other words... it is this way.

I opened the package she handed me...
and inside was
a photo album.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
This is a photo from the day my debut was decided.
The day I shot a movie with Vodka and Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
This one's from summer training camp.
It's a photo taken right when we arrived at the lodge.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
This is Hatsumode.
And this is a photo from when we made chocolate for Valentine's Day.

Filled with things I remembered and things I didn't...
it was quite a thick album.
choice_data_list: Is that... could it be, three years' worth?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I've carefully selected them.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Thank goodness.
That's the most important thing.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Mar-chan also
had fun making it."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"...Maybe I'll make another one. Every three years.
An album every three years."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Please look forward to it, okay?

I opened the package she handed me...
and inside was
a single letter.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Even for Machan, you see.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Even for Chan,
having a letter read right in front of her
is a bit too much.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And that's that...
See ya later~

Before I could stop her, she hurried off home.
She must have put a great deal of heart into it.
I promptly open the letter--

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"To Trainer,
Thank you, always."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"‘Everything you've done for Mar-chan, every single bit of it,
I remember it all.’"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan's Letter
text_block_list.text: "Since it was a Christmas present, I wanted it to be something really special, so I thought about it a whole lot!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan's Letter
text_block_list.text: "However, I was at a loss, so I ended up doing this—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan's Letter
text_block_list.text: "Do you understand?"
There was nothing inside the envelope besides the letter.

Wondering if I had missed something, I shook it up and down—
and a faint, elegant scent drifted into the air.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"It is special. A custom blend,
a scent that belongs to no one and nowhere else."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"So please remember this
as the scent of Christmas."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan's Letter
text_block_list.text: "‘It's the scent of Christmas with Mar-chan.’"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"‘Whether in town, on the train, or at home
someday. I hope you'll look back on today.’"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan's Letter
text_block_list.text: "Merry Christmas."
I instinctively looked back toward the door she had just exited through.

The fragrance of Christmas that drifted through the room
did not fade for quite some time.
